posts.title: Atmospheric Automated Development
posts.description: Marking a piece of feedback 'planned' kicks off an autonomous coding agent that implements it and opens a draft PR. Built with userinput.app, airglow, and GitHub Actions, without touching the app.

posts.title: Atmospheric Feedback
posts.description: Two ways to collect feedback in your Atmosphere apps — bug reports and feature requests via userinput.app, and reviews via atstore.fyi — using progressive scoping to request permissions on demand without overwhelming users.

posts.title: Atmospheric Login Page
posts.description: The UX decisions behind my Atmosphere apps login pages — saved handles, handle autocomplete, and a 'create account' guardrail that slows people down on purpose.
